flags.summary: The FWCS board approved his termination as part of its consent agenda in September 2026, effective May 22; the district's May 14 termination letter said it had lost confidence in his leadership and cited "a pattern of concerns, including but not limited to employee complaints," the climate and culture of the school and "violation of written directives".
